name: Whispers Within: Halloween Terror
summary: Step into a dark forest armed with only a flashlight and your nerve as you search for 9 eerie dolls hidden deep in the woods. But you are not alone. A relentless monster stalks your every move, turning every path, locked door, and shadowy clearing into a fight to survive. Search for keys, keycards, and fuel to push deeper into the forest, uncover optional notes and recordings that hint at the truth, and stay one step ahead of the terror hunting you. Whispers Within is a tense first-person horror experience built around exploration, pursuit, and dread.
